notes.title: Steam Cards Now Available!
notes.notes:
We hope everyone has been enjoying Nie no Hakoniwa - Dollhouse of Offerings. With everyone's support, the game has reached a Mostly Positive rating on Steam! Every review counts so we greatly appreciate it.

Today we are also pleased to announce that Steam Cards are now available! In addition, from now [b]till March 21st[/b], Nie no Hakoniwa - Dollhouse of Offerings will be on sale with a 20% discount. In addition with the recently launched [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39456/Nie_no_Hakoniwa_Complete/]Nie no Hakoniwa Complete Bundle[/url], it's a great time to pick up this game as well as the amazing soundtrack featuring music by MANYO and vocal tracks by Shimotsuki Haruka.

Of course if you have points to burn, the background wallpaper and emotes are available to purchase from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/2527450/]Steam Points Shop[/url].

notes.title: Nie no Hakoniwa - Dollhouse of Offerings Original Soundtrack Coming to Steam
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that the soundtrack to Nie no Hakoniwa - Dollhouse of Offerings will be coming to Steam on March 8, 2024!

The soundtrack features 26 tracks composed by veteran game composer, MANYO (CARTAGRA, Heaven Burns Red, FLOWERS series). The soundtrack also features both the opening and ending theme songs with lyrics and vocals by Shimotsuki Haruka (Atelier series, Legend of Mana, FLOWERS series, Ar nosurge, Ciel nosurge)

The soundtrack along with the game will be also made available as part of a Steam bundle very soon. This will give users a chance to save a little bit more when purchasing both the game and the OST.

Nie no Hakoniwa has now reached over 65 reviews with a Mostly Positive rating. A big thanks to everyone who has played the game and given it a review. Every review counts and helps this game to reach a larger audience.
